title: AC1021 metric corpus strict refusal on typed proxy graphics
scope: Identify the first strict-output gate for one distinct local AC1021 corpus drawing. This records a refusal and does not qualify proxy-graphics preservation or whole-document support.

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local corpus input; not modified or committed by this investigation.

converter.diagnostic: DXF export preflight failed: typed-proxy-graphics-not-preserved count=2 firstHandle=165230

interpretation: Two typed INSERT proxy caches block strict output. ODA §29 identifies the 15 type-19 chunks as marker-index controls; ezdxf independently reads the marker values and decodes both exact extracted streams to 231 and 259 POLYLINE/TEXT virtual entities. This does not establish INSERT cache source association, exact DXF output/readback, or native display. The existing fail-closed gate remains correct.
nextAction: Establish whether the source proxy stream is semantically attached to each INSERT or its referenced block, and whether DXF permits exact same-version cache replay for this entity type. Bind output bytes to the source INSERT and block graph, then verify exact group 310 readback and a native consumer before admitting the profile.
nonClaims: No proxy-graphics semantic or replay support is established.
No whole-document AC1021 conversion support is established.
No source fixture was added or modified.

probe.method: A temporary local C++ probe imported the exact source through dx_iface and enumerated typed entities, provenance and DRW_ProxyGraphicDecoder::inspect results.
probe.result: Chunk histogram: handle 0x2856E has opcode counts 19:7, 22:231, 23:231, 29:1, 31:1, 32:165, 38:66; handle 0x2A974 has 19:8, 22:259, 23:259, 29:1, 31:1, 32:184, 38:75. Opcodes 22/23 are attribute controls and 29/31 matrix controls handled by decode; 32/38 are recognized primitive types. Opcode 19 is not named in the current decoder. The inspect API's non-primitive count is not an unsupported-opcode count.

specificationEvidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §29, Proxy Entity Graphics
specificationEvidence.finding: Type 19 is SUBENT_MARKER and its payload is one RL marker index. The spec also defines proxy graphic chunks as RL size, RL type, then type-specific bytes.
specificationEvidence.scopeLimit: This defines the chunk role and wire payload, not whether INSERT proxy caches may be replayed as DXF proxy graphics or how a native consumer should display them.

independentDecoderEvidence.finding: The independent decoder names type 19 ATTRIBUTE_MARKER and reads a 32-bit marker index; both extracted streams decode completely to virtual entities.
independentDecoderEvidence.scopeLimit: This is byte-stream decoding only. It does not prove source INSERT-to-proxy semantic association, DXF writer preservation, or native application behavior.
